policy: Primary official sources only for executable regulatory facts. NBC, NPC and CEC text is not copied. Unverified details become MISSING_INFORMATION or UNCERTAIN.

sources.title: New building codes take effect March 31

sources.organization: Canadian Board for Harmonized Construction Codes
sources.title: Provincial/Territorial adoption
sources.usedFor: PEI row: NBC 2020 Energy Performance Tier 1 adopted in full, enforcement 31 March 2024 (table as of August 2024). NPC 2020 and NECB 2020 listed as adopted in full from the same date.

sources.title: Building Codes Regulations, PEI Reg EC177/20
sources.usedFor: Section 2 adoption wording (NBC 2020 with Schedules A and B; NECB 2020). Not treated as the official Gazette. NECB is not assumed as this Part 9 house’s energy path.

sources.title: Building Codes Act, R.S.P.E.I. 1988, Cap. B-5.1
sources.usedFor: Enabling statute for code adoption by regulation.

sources.title: National Building Code of Canada 2020
sources.usedFor: Existence and edition of NBC 2020. No code text ingested.

sources.title: Codes Canada publications

sources.title: A Code for Plumbing Services Regulations (office consolidation)
sources.usedFor: Adopts National Plumbing Code of Canada 2020 as amended from time to time, current to 31 March 2024 (EC180/24). PEI additions concern permits. NPC clause text is not encoded.

sources.title: Electrical Inspection and Code Regulations, PEI Reg EC757/18
sources.usedFor: Office consolidation current to 5 October 2024. Adopts 2024 Canadian Electrical Code, Part 1, Twenty-sixth Edition, with Schedule 1 PEI amendments. CEC text is not reproduced.
